moat_against: Walmart competes for the same value customer with deeper pockets
Dollar Tree/Family Dollar and Amazon pressure the same basket; zero switching costs
Shrink and store-condition/labor issues broke earnings in FY2023-24 and can recur
Core low-income customer squeezed by fuel/food inflation
moat_for: Rural/small-town store density and proximity (~20,900 stores) — closest trip for consumables
Low-cost small-box operating model hard to undercut at this ticket size
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow: ~20,900-store rural proximity and purchasing scale are real advantages in small-town markets, but there is no pricing power against Walmart, no switching costs, a low-margin consumables mix, and a financially squeezed core customer; the FY2023-24 shrink crisis showed how fast the economics can break.
name: Dollar General Corp
one_liner: Genuine turnaround at a narrow-moat rural discounter, but $130 already prices in the recovery — weighted IRR 11.0%, IV@15 $87; clears 15% only below ~$87.
